description: Three exact-anchor ordinary-assertion mutations for Line public geometry contracts.

mutants.test_filter: Transforming a 3D line applies rotation and translation to both endpoints
mutants.description: Drop affine translation; the exact analytic endpoint checks must fail.

mutants.test_filter: Line clipping and 3D plane intersection return analytic endpoints
mutants.description: Use the exit point for both clipped endpoints; the entry/exit assertions must fail.

mutants.test_filter: Line clipping and 3D plane intersection return analytic endpoints
mutants.description: Compute interpolation as if the segment began at z=0; the independent plane point must fail.
